status: Author self-check complete; independent review and Claude approval are not represented here.
scope: Only five front (+z) paw meshes appended to the approved project banner. All images/4800 cases are synthetic factory contexts with no heroId; banner has zero real users.

origin.kind: Reuse of project-authored procedural paw geometry, adapted to the existing real triangulated front cloth.

method: Author-only self-check from a complete frozen 300-file runtime clone. Baseline helper is the real git-show blob at fixed 68e3f1d, normal cat/pose/actor/renderer are identical. Isolated BACK stores full primitive triangles including normally expanded outlines; separate normal-baked cats provide actual eye-core12x12 sample-ID sets, active smile/mouthO3x3 grids, dynamic five nose/mouth points and whole FRAME. Full actual skull1120/skull-outline1120/muzzle560 convex clipping plus every real ear outer/inner/tuft/outline triangle, no nominal-radius or vertex-only inference. Relative matrix caching preserves complete physical records and no per-frame builder calls.

sampleEvidence.schema: rows columns [id,pose,t,yaw,suite,measurementIndex]. Exact measurementDictionary entries contain old/new own+whole four-edge margins/finite/clippedBones, all concrete valid/blocked eye12 IDs, dynamic mouth3x3 IDs, five nose/mouth blocked IDs, eye scales and full physical dictionary references. rawPhysical dictionaries retain every mesh/outline record and triangle-ID array. No rounding.

opaqueFrontContact.method: Every newfront primary+normal-expanded outline fulltriangle surface against all actualopaque closed cloth triangles; separate actualrear face triangle set. Contact must include opaque primary mesh, never outline-only.

packedExactRecords.schema: Full triangle-ID arrays; repeated toe names remain distinct ordered records.

packedExactTriangleRecords.schema: Identity-deduplicated exact complete triangle-depth records; contexts recordDictionaryIndices preserve original per-mesh order. XY clipping of all triangles, including degenerate projections, against actual rear cloth cells; exact gap at every clipped polygon vertex.

nativeChecks.execution: The initial default sandbox test attempt blocked Node spawnSync (EPERM) in CLI tests. The unchanged source was rerun with the permitted additional network process capability; all native tests passed. No test or dependency changes.

limitations: Discrete phase0 poses/times/yaws and these 24 synthetic looks only; not a continuous-motion proof or future clothing/assignment coverage. Old five rear paws are preserved byte for byte; new front attachment/clearance proof is not asserted for every old rear paw. Current source/photo baseline is intentionally fixed at 68e3f1d, not newly merged 560f54c. Independent QA is still to be performed by root-assigned reviewer.
